premises.text: Public data reflecting the real world is valuable but inaccessible because it lives in heterogeneous siloed formats with no cross-source search or relationship discovery
premises.evidence_span: While this data is public, and while it is out there, it's not really accessible

premises.text: Enigma provides scalable infrastructure for acquiring, indexing, and searching public data across large numbers of datasets
premises.evidence_span: we're building a scalable infrastructure for acquiring, indexing, and searching public data

premises.text: Users can find, filter, and manipulate datasets to discover relationships and datasets they did not know existed
premises.evidence_span: let you find and manipulate the data you're looking for

premises.text: A browser plugin lights up entities on web pages and routes users into Enigma at granular dataset level
premises.evidence_span: with our browser plugin, it's on the right. It's going to enable it. All of the entities on the page light up

premises.text: Web app and API launch with institutional partners who consume public data in finance, media, and research
premises.evidence_span: we're launching our web app and API with partners who really share this vision
